description: This file defines a Java interface 'MappingFunction' that extends the standard 'Function<I, O>' interface. It provides a default method to build a 'MessageMappingFailedException' from a Rhino JavaScript engine exception, including detailed error information such as line source and script stack trace.

methods.name: buildMessageMappingFailedException
methods.description: Constructs a MessageMappingFailedException from a RhinoException, including message, line/column info, optional source code, and stack trace.
